description: Browse geographic regions; sort by provider/API count. Returns the 18 regions themselves. The collection also holds region x industry crossover pages (nordics-healthcare and 1,097 more); those are excluded unless you ask for them with type.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use with `limit` to walk a long list.

q.description: Free text matched against name and description, e.g. "payments".

sort.description: Order: name, api_count, provider_count or composite, e.g. "provider_count".

type.description: Which record kind to list. `region` (default) is the dimension itself; `region-industry` is the crossover pages; `all` is both.

name: find_regions
